## Today {.inverse}

<span class="kicker">MON AUG 24 · 1-4 PM</span>

Move from a table to a defensible comparison: **plot, model, diagnose, explain**.

## The claim ladder

| Claim | Example | Here? |
|---|---|---|
| Descriptive | Mortality declined in observed countries | Yes |
| Associational | Income is associated with mortality | Yes |
| Causal | Income caused mortality to fall | No |

## See the scale

```{.r}
ggplot(health, aes(log_income,
                   under5_mortality,
                   color = income_level)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

Label the units. Name the sample. Inspect surprises.

## Summarize the relationship

```{.r}
fit <- lm(
  under5_mortality ~ log_income + income_level,
  data = health
)

summary(fit)
```

A coefficient is not a mechanism.
